verdict.rationale: Polar publishes versioned, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 specs and llms.txt/.md docs siblings (confirmed live via probe), and provides a sandbox environment for testing calls, which together support API exploration; however there is no direct evidence of an actual interactive reference UI (e.g., a Swagger/Stoplight-style 'try it out' page) with runnable request examples embedded in the docs. missing for 10: explicit interactive API reference UI, in-page runnable/executable examples, independent confirmation of a live 'try it' console.
